verdict: CBB (Paolo 7/26/26) - ships, FROZEN, never spawns variants
law: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_ART_FIRST_RESET_7_26_26.md amendment B - machine-gate the PROXIES only. The gestalt "does it look like the target" is ALWAYS a human verdict, Paolo's, and is NEVER an image diff.

frozen.note: changing either of these requires a NEW RULING FROM PAOLO, not a new render. CBB does not get quietly improved.

palette.rule: a cook may not raise the corpus colour count above the ceiling

proxies.value_band_rule: each layer has its OWN measured band and a new tile whose layer mean falls more than 26 outside it is not in this world. The ordering is NOT assumed - it is measured, and in this target it comes out top brightest, then ground, then wall, because the yard is bare sun-struck dirt and the walls are the faces sitting in their own eave shadow. Writing "ground darkest" here would have been a guess that the numbers contradict.

outline.rule: NO black keyline. Edges are value steps.

dither.rule: act 1 does not stipple. Falloffs are solid alpha ramps.

light.rule: ONE direction everywhere. A mass is brightest on top.

glow.rule: act 1 windows are DEAD DARK glass. Never a warm night glow.

seams.rule: tiles in one family must meet identically - their edge rings hash the same. Hashable, per amendment B.

never_gated: whether a thing LOOKS right. That is Paolo, side by side, forever. A literal image-diff gate is gameable and false and is banned.
